title: Rifts: Promise of Power
statusNote: Logos, main menu, options and character creation work; after the story slideshow the first scene plays: the conversation with Larson, picking up the bag, then walking around the map, rotating the view, the area map and the pause menu.
notes: The OK key (pad press) does nothing in this game: 5 is the action and select key and 7 cancels. The layout here puts 5 on Enter and Space and 7 on Backspace and Escape.

Start Game leads through choosing a character class, Preset or Custom, and a name (the digits type letters; move down to Accept and press 5). The story slideshow that follows takes about two minutes and cannot be skipped.
The keys can be changed in the game under Options > Controller.
Bluetooth and N-Gage Arena in the main menu are multiplayer and online features that cannot work here.

controls.source: The game's Options > Controller screen (its defaults) for the digit keys. Moving, 5 selecting in menus and conversations, 2 and 3 turning the view, 9 opening the map, 7 closing it, the soft keys and OK doing nothing were observed in play.

actions.5: Action; select in menus; next line in conversations

notes: Keyboard: the standard layout, except that Enter and Space press 5 and Backspace and Escape press 7. Gamepad: A is 5 (action), B is 7 (cancel), X is info, Y is the map, the shoulder buttons rotate the view, the left trigger switches character, Start and Back are the soft keys.
